title: Filters
summary: Sun-soaked treatments shown on the sample clip: a sunset grade as the base look, comic-ink and print looks that turn footage into a drawn panel, warm light for accents and quick moves for cuts. Previews run at full strength; use far less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "sunset_grade", "amount": 0.6}}} and {"name": "pop_flash", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.25, "amount": 0.6}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "comic_ink", "amount": 0.8, "where": "in"}}. Engine: library/_shared/effects_engine.py (OpenCV).

items.name: sunset grade
items.description: The theme base look: richer colour, warm highlights, violet shadows and a faint pink wash from the top. Use around 0.6 on footage.

items.name: sun bloom
items.description: Film warmth: highlights spill orange, then pink, and the blacks lift a touch.

items.name: vhs vacation
items.description: A holiday tape left in the sun: faded and warm, colour smeared sideways, a soft tracking band.

items.name: halation
items.description: Bright areas glow red-orange, like light bleeding through film.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Darkens the corners to hold the eye in the middle.

items.name: grain
items.description: Fine film grain.

items.name: comic ink
items.description: Flat posterised colour with dark ink outlines: the picture redrawn as a comic panel.

items.name: cel shade
items.description: Smooth cel bands with a thin ink line and a warm rim on the highlights. Gentler than comic ink.

items.name: halftone print
items.description: Four-colour dot screens on cream paper, like cheap offset print.

items.name: pop flash
items.description: A flash in the theme colours, pink at the top through orange to yellow. For cuts and slams.

items.name: light leak
items.description: A warm streak of light drifts across the frame.

items.name: film burn
items.description: A hot orange burn travels across the picture.

items.name: bloom
items.description: Highlights glow softly.

items.name: whip
items.description: A fast sideways blur, as if the camera whipped round.

items.name: zoom blur
items.description: The picture rushes toward the viewer.

items.name: camera shake
items.description: A handheld jolt for impacts.

items.name: ripple
items.description: Rings spread from the centre like a stone dropped in water.

items.name: chromatic
items.description: Colour fringes toward the edges, like a cheap lens.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
